research_notes: The coarse search should remain monotonic in target classes until the first credible failed upper class.
Changing both runtime and planned gap simultaneously would reduce interpretability, so gap remains fixed.
Changing to parallel execution before the cap is validated would likewise confound runtime survival evidence.
The eventual cap should be chosen for repeated reliability, not maximum one-off duration.
The future policy comparison should measure unnecessary early handoff as well as unsafe overshoot.
The final contract should remain simple enough to execute reliably under long-turn pressure.
